blogPosts.title: Why Every Personal Brand Needs a Website
blogPosts.excerpt: A website gives your work a permanent home, builds trust, and helps people find you through search.
blogPosts.body: Social media is important, but a personal website gives your brand a stable foundation. It lets you present your services, projects, story, blog posts, and contact links in one professional place. With SEO, your portfolio can also bring visitors from Google over time.
